newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Banco de Galicia upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Banco de Galicia upgraded.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said on Tuesday it had upgraded its rating for Argentina's Banco de Galicia to buy from long-term buy.

-- "Banco de Galicia's first-quarter earnings of $28.4 million were above our $24.7 million estimate and 15.9 percent higher than in the fourth-quarter of 1996," analyst Jorge Scarinci wrote in a report.

-- "Overall, Banco de Galicia posted a satisfactory first quarter, on the back of high interest income and other non-interest income. ... We continue to believe that a recovery of the economy will allow BG to post improving results in coming quarters, putting the bank in a privileged position among its local peers."
-- The bank's American Depositary Receipts were trading up 1/2 at 20 in late-afternoon trade.
